text:
### Variable Rate  
**BoE Base + Margin:** 1.50%–2.25% depending on LTV
name: Chunk 18/34

raw_entities.name: Variable Rate Product
raw_entities.description: A variable rate savings or lending product where the interest rate is calculated as the Bank of England Base Rate plus a margin that varies between 1.50% and 2.25% depending on the Loan-to-Value ratio of the customer's collateral or account tier.
context: BoE Base + Margin: 1.50%–2.25% depending on LTV

raw_entities.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio
raw_entities.description: A dynamic variable representing the ratio of the loan amount to the value of the collateral or account tier, used to determine the applicable margin tier within the variable rate product structure.

raw_entities.name: Margin Rate
raw_entities.description: A variable placeholder representing the margin percentage added to the Bank of England Base Rate, ranging from 1.50% to 2.25% based on LTV tier classification.
context: BoE Base + Margin: 1.50%–2.25% depending on LTV
